approvalPage.title: Post approvals
approvalPage.description: Review content, make decisions and follow approval history in this workspace.
approvalPage.allCaughtUpDesc: No content waiting for your review right now.

review.copyFailed: Could not copy content. Please try again.
review.title: Result approval

hint.submit: The saved content below will be sent to the Manager. Editing is locked while it is in review.
hint.withdraw: The task returns to In progress and the post can be edited. Resubmission starts a new round from the Manager.
hint.approve: Check the current content before confirming. Client approval follows if required; the last step finishes the task without publishing the post.
hint.reject: Your reason is recorded in the approval history. The Creator edits the current post and resubmits to the Manager in a new round.

success.reject: Result rejected and changes requested from the Creator.

review.emptyCaption: The post has no caption yet.
review.mediaUnavailable: This attachment cannot be displayed. Check it before approving.
review.contentUnavailable: No linked post is available. The Creator needs to start the task and save a post in the editor.
review.contentMismatch: The loaded content and review state do not match. Reload before making a decision.
review.reloadBeforeRetry: Your note is preserved. Reload and check the latest content, then explicitly confirm again; the decision is never retried automatically.
review.actionUnavailable: This action is no longer available. Your note is preserved; check the latest state before closing.
review.reasonRequired: Enter a rejection reason, not only whitespace.
review.noteTooLong: The note must not exceed 5,000 characters.
review.discardNote: This note has not been sent. Continue writing or discard it?
review.historyNoContentVersions: History records decisions and notes by round, not earlier content versions. The content above is always the current post. Withdrawals do not create artificial rejection decisions.
review.noHistory: No approval or rejection decisions yet.
review.finishedHint: The task is finished. Publishing is a separate action; this decision does not publish the post.

errors.generic: Approval could not be processed. Reload to check the outcome before trying again.
errors.TASK_SCHEMA_NOT_READY: The approval schema is not ready. Ask an administrator to check the migration; do not run init on existing data.
errors.TASK_REVIEW_INTEGRATION_NOT_READY: Task-linked approval is not enabled in this environment. Data remains readable; wait until integration is complete before using it.
errors.TASK_REVIEW_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED: Content approval is not integrated for this task type. Only Posts are supported for now; other types will be connected later.
errors.TASK_REVIEW_CLIENT_REQUIRED: No active Client account is available to approve. Ask the Manager to add one; the Client step is never skipped automatically.
errors.TASK_REVIEW_MANAGER_REQUIRED: No active Manager can receive the submission. Check the Workspace membership.
errors.TASK_POST_LINK_REQUIRED: No linked post is available. The Creator must save a post in the editor before submitting.
errors.TASK_POST_LINK_CONFLICT: The task–post link needs checking. Do not create a replacement post to bypass this error.
errors.TASK_START_HISTORY_UNVERIFIED: The legacy task start history is unverified. Ask an administrator to review it; do not reset its state.
errors.TASK_REVISION_CONFLICT: The task changed. Reload its state and content before deciding again.
errors.TASK_APPROVAL_ROUND_CONFLICT: The approval round changed. Reload and check the current round before deciding.
errors.POST_CONTENT_CONFLICT: The post content changed. Reload and read it before deciding; your note is preserved.
errors.TASK_REVIEW_STATE_CONFLICT: The task or post state no longer permits this action. If the post returned to draft, only authorized withdrawal or rejection can reopen editing.
errors.TASK_REVIEW_CONTENT_LOCKED: The content is in review or finalized and cannot be edited.
errors.TASK_WITHDRAW_NOT_ALLOWED: Withdrawal is no longer allowed; it is available only before the Manager decides.
errors.TASK_NOT_SUBMITTED: The task has no active approval submission.
errors.TASK_CAMPAIGN_COMPLETED: The Campaign is completed and does not accept further approval actions.
errors.WRONG_APPROVAL_STEP: You cannot decide at the current step. Reload the review state.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You no longer have permission for this action. Check your role and Workspace membership.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session is no longer valid. Please sign in again.
errors.TASK_NOT_FOUND: The task could not be found in this Workspace.
errors.POST_NOT_FOUND: The linked post could not be found. Check with the Creator.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: The approval input is invalid. Check the post content and note before retrying.
errors.TASK_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: Task storage is temporarily unavailable. Keep your note and reload later.
errors.TASK_TRANSACTIONS_UNAVAILABLE: Approval cannot be processed safely yet. Ask an administrator to check the database connection.

readOnly: Showing actual data. Dragging to change status or dates is not supported in this release.

publishDateMustBeAfterDueDate: Publish date must be after task due date (deadline)!

panel.hint: Review requirements, assign and start work alongside the task list.

workflow.invalidReferences: Check reference titles and HTTP(S) URLs.
workflow.invalidDate: Invalid time, outside the allowed dates, or ambiguous/nonexistent due to daylight saving time.
